sutta: now we come to the next seven point sorry 7.7.64 the buddha said monks endowed with these seven qualities among is worthy of offerings is the world's peerless field for merit with what seven monks hearing among is a dhamma nor meaning nor self nor measure nor time nor assembly nor noble or base person no and how is among dhamma here in monks among knows dhamma the discourses or sutas unless he know the discourses he should not be called a dhamma no and how is he a meaning no here in monks among knows the meaning of this and that speech such is the meaning of this speech such of that unless he know each meaning he should not be called a knower of the meaning but because he knows such is the meaning of this speech such of that therefore he is called the knower of the meaning and how is he a self-knower here in monks among those of self thus far am i in faith in virtue in learning in generosity in wisdom and in ready with unless he know this he should not be called a self-knower but because he knows of self thus far am i in faith in virtue and so forth therefore he is called a self-knower and how is he a measure noah here in monks among knows measure in accepting the requisites that is to say the rope arms lodging and medicines unless he know this he should not be called and noah of measure but because he knows measure in accepting the requisites therefore he is called the noah of measure and how is he a time nor here in monks a monk knows the time thus this is the time for recitation this for questioning this for effort this for solitude unless he know this he should not be called the time noah but because he knows the time for recitation for questioning and so forth therefore he is called a time lord and how is he an assembly noah here in monks and among those assemblies thus this is an assembly of nobles this obra means this of householders list of recluses there one should approach in such a way stand us sit speak and be silent so unless he knows this he should not be called a noah of assemblies but because he knows an assembly of nobles an assembly of brahmins and so forth therefore he is called the noah of assemblies and how is he a noble and based person know herein monks persons are known to among in two ways of two persons one desires to see the aryans the other does not this one who has no desire to see the aryans is to be blamed for that reason but the other because he desires to see the aryans is to be commanded of the two who desire to see the aryans one desires to hear saddam or the true dhamma the other does not the letter is to be blamed for that reason the former is to be commanded of the two who desire to hear saddam one listens to dhamma with ready ear the other does not the letter is to be blamed the former is to be commanded of two who listen to dhamma with ready ear one having heard it is mindful of dhamma the other is not the latter is to be blamed the former is to be commanded of two who having heard it are mindful of dhamma one tests the truth of the doctrines he has learned the other does not the latter is to be blamed the former is to be commended of two who test the truth of the doctrines learned one knowing the letter and the spirit walks in conformity with dhamma the other does not the letter is to be blamed the former is to be commanded of two persons who knowing the letter and the spirit wrong in conformity with dhamma one conforms for his own benefit but not for others the other conforms both for his own benefit and for the benefit of others the person who conforms for his own benefit and not for others is to be blamed for that reason the person who conforms both for his own benefit and for the benefit of others is to be commanded for that reason thus monks persons are known to among in two ways and thus among is a nor of noble and base persons verily monks endowed with these seven qualities among is worthy of offerings and is the world's fearless field for marriage that's the end of the suta here there are seven things but among the first one is means a person who knows the suttas or discourses of the buddha a meaning noah is one who knows the ready read et cetera a measure noah is a man who knows measure in accepting the requisites a time noah is a monk who knows the time whether it is a suitable time for chanting a suitable time for
